itineraries.title: Five days in the Aeolian Islands
itineraries.intro: Stromboli after dark, black-sand anchorages off Panarea and long volcanic ridgelines from Milazzo.

days.note: Board in Milazzo; cross to Vulcano for the mud baths.
The castle and the pumice cliffs; dinner in the town.
Malvasia at Santa Marina; Pollara’s bay for a swim.
Cala Junco and the islets; the island’s summer evening.
The Sciara del Fuoco after dark; return to Milazzo.

itineraries.title: Seven days from Catania around the Aeolians
itineraries.intro: Taormina, then every island of the Aeolian arc, ending in Milazzo.

days.note: Board in Catania; Etna from the water.
The Greek theatre and Isola Bella.
The Gran Cratere and the black beaches.
The castle, the pumice cliffs and Lipari town.
Pollara bay and the Malvasia vineyards.
Cala Junco and the islets of Basiluzzo.
The eruptions after dark; disembark in Milazzo.
